name: Neon Null
storyline: Reality is collapsing into the Null, a digital void that consumes entire sectors of existence. As the last surviving pilot, you dive into corrupted space to fight through hostile anomalies, recover lost data, and uncover the force behind the collapse before everything is erased.
summary:
Reality is collapsing into the Null, a digital void that consumes entire sectors of existence. As the last surviving pilot, you dive into corrupted space to fight through hostile anomalies, recover lost data, and uncover the force behind the collapse before everything is erased.

Every run presents a new challenge. Enemy formations, hazards, and upgrade opportunities shift from one attempt to the next, forcing you to adjust your strategy on the fly. Powerful builds can emerge quickly, but a single mistake can end a run just as fast.

Progress doesn't stop when you fail. Unlock new upgrades, expand your arsenal, and discover abilities that open new ways to approach future runs. Each attempt helps you push farther, survive longer, and tackle increasingly difficult encounters.

Built around responsive controls and rapid-fire action, Neon Null rewards skill, experimentation, and persistence. The farther you travel into the fractured cosmos, the more dangerous and unpredictable it becomes.
